findings.title: PR body says the 15 RPCs had no pgTAP references and that no test would catch a removed guard. That is false.
findings.evidence:
PR Summary says the RPCs "had no pgTAP references before". PR Problem says "None of these 15 RPCs had pgTAP coverage (GAP-B1)... If someone removed or reordered an authorization guard, no database test would catch it." At base 084b48c, `git grep -w` over supabase/tests finds 4 of the 15 already referenced:
- api_publish_quote_package: quote_publication_helper_privileges.sql:61-62 already throws_ok 'Only internal users can publish quote packages.' for an ordinary client, which is an authorization-guard test. Also referenced in quote_selection_publication_contract.sql:64,79.
- api_cancel_quote_request: free_quote_job_meter.sql:43,110,135 and free_quote_terminal_lifecycle.sql:274,286.
- api_select_quote_option: quote_selection_expiry.sql:92-177.
- api_list_client_quote_workspace: quote_lane_eligibility.sql:350,374.
Even origin/main 8d8d243 already references 2 of them. The claim came from the spec's GAP-B1 note. It does not affect the suite's correctness.
findings.suggested_fix: Reword to say that none of the 15 had anon/cross-org/unverified least-privilege coverage, and that 4 had functional or partial references (name them).

findings.title: PR body is out of date on CI and Sonar, and the 27 new Sonar issues have no dispositions
findings.evidence:
At a5922ec all 15 check runs concluded success. That includes the test job's step 14, "Test database policies after independent-session replacement". Its admitPgProve (scripts/run-supabase-policy-tests.mjs:45-55) requires every staged file to run, including the new one, with PASS and no not ok/SKIP/TODO. The body still says "Hosted CI at this head is still pending" and leaves the AC5 box unchecked.

The body also says "Sonar: not yet run". SonarCloud Code Analysis has run: Quality Gate passed with 27 new issues, and this file is the only change. AGENTS.md:56 requires inspecting the Sonar issue list at the final head and recording dispositions.

The S1192 disposition ("no string literal appears 3 or more times") comes from a local count that does not treat psql `:'var'` interpolations as literals. A SQL tokenizer reads them as literals: 'raised' 33x, 'job_a' 24x, 'org_a' 20x, 'signed_in' 9x, and so on. That could account for most of the 27 issues. I could not read the issue list: sonarcloud.io returns 403 through the proxy.
findings.suggested_fix: Mark CI green at a5922ec. Record Sonar as run (QG passed, 27 new issues) and add dispositions. If the list cannot be read from this container, say so under not_verified_here and have it checked on hosted Sonar.

The assertions would still pass if internal-user scoping broke, for example if is_internal_user were checked against the caller's own org instead of the row's org. findings.title: The anon deviations from the spec are not in the 'Spec deviation' section
findings.evidence:
The spec expects anon to get "the exact SQLSTATE and message, or permission denied".
